title: 1inch Adds Four Stock-Linked Tokens on Base, Including Microsoft and AMD
why_it_matters: The addition broadens the range of equity-linked assets available through a decentralized swap interface, but around-the-clock access does not establish share ownership rights, uniform liquidity or eligibility in every jurisdiction.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

1inch Adds Four Stock-Linked Tokens on Base, Including Microsoft and AMD

The November expansion adds tokens linked to Microsoft, AMD, Sony and Take-Two to 1inch's Base offering, with swaps accessible through its app and wallet.
